CVE-2026-104357.title: Libtirpc: libtirpc: sunrpc udp datagram-boundary violation (stale buffer bytes decoded as current request)
CVE-2026-104357.description: A flaw was found in libtirpc. The SunRPC UDP/datagram server transport reuses a single receive buffer across requests and resets the XDR decode position without rebinding the decode length to the size of the datagram actually received. As a result, when a short UDP RPC request is received after a longer one, the XDR decoder can read stale bytes left in the reused buffer and interpret them as part of the current request, including credential, verifier, or procedure-argument fields. The highest threat from this vulnerability is to data confidentiality and integrity for services that use a UDP-based SunRPC server.

io_run_task_work()
cond_resched()
worker->cur_work = linked
